decision: retain v0.4 weights; reject short-window candidates; offer explicit complete-tail batch policy

temporal_protocol.hypothesis: Short windows preserve local physical deviations diluted by a minute.
temporal_protocol.metric_contract: Max score per common complete minute for AP, precision, false alert minutes and interval detection; fine-window event localization reported separately.
temporal_protocol.threshold: q99 of max minute scores on normal calibration minutes only; strict nextafter cutoff
temporal_protocol.selection: More physical events, no loss of total events, precision >=0.5, no increase in false alert minutes. Require fine-window physical detections >= baseline physical detections as a localization guard. Rank eligible by physical then total events then fewer false minutes.

tail_frozen.policy: window.tail_policy: complete; window_end <= last observed timestamp of its run/asset
tail_frozen.acceptance: No loss of detected events or physical detections, fewer false alert minutes. Report excluded coverage and events without windows. No physical-learning improvement claim.
